name: prismpath-flows
description: Editor surface for prismpath flow files: tier-aware edge highlighting, a live playground preview (the conformance-tested JS kernel — no Python needed), and validate-on-save diagnostics.

prismpath.validateCommand.markdownDescription: Command run on save against flow files (`<cmd> <file> --json`); findings become squiggles on their `## node` lines. Clear it to disable. Use `python3 -m prismpath.cli validate` if `prismpath` is not on PATH. The preview needs NO Python — this is the one optional Python touchpoint.

scripts.test: node --test test/*.test.mjs && node --check extension.js && node --check scripts/sync.mjs
